name: @vnb4-toeic/database
description: PostgreSQL schema, Prisma migrations, and seed data for TOEIC vocab platform

scripts.env:init: test -f .env.local && echo '.env.local exists' || { cp .env.local.example .env.local && echo 'wrote .env.local (SQLite, no Docker needed)'; }
scripts.env:init:prod: test -f .env && echo '.env exists' || { cp .env.example .env && echo 'wrote .env (edit DATABASE_URL for your Postgres)'; }
scripts.migrate:local: pnpm env:init && dotenv -e .env.local -- prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.local.prisma
scripts.migrate:dev: pnpm env:init:prod && dotenv -e .env -- prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:prod: pnpm env:init:prod && dotenv -e .env -- prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.studio: pnpm env:init && pnpm prisma:generate && dotenv -e .env.local -- prisma studio --schema prisma/schema.local.prisma
scripts.studio:prod: pnpm env:init:prod && pnpm prisma:generate:prod && dotenv -e .env -- prisma studio --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.seed: pnpm env:init && pnpm prisma:generate && dotenv -e .env.local -- tsx seeds/run.ts
scripts.seed:prod: pnpm env:init:prod && pnpm prisma:generate:prod && dotenv -e .env -- tsx seeds/run.ts
scripts.seed:reset: dotenv -e .env.local -- prisma db push --force-reset --schema prisma/schema.local.prisma && pnpm seed
